post_text:
14 days since Day 6.
I'm back.
And the data didn't wait.

America's school attendance crisis is bigger than most people realize.

15% of students were chronically absent before COVID.
By 2022 that number hit 31%.
Today — still 23.5%. Still nearly 60% above where we started.

I mapped 7 years of absenteeism data across every state.
The recovery is real. But it is uneven.
And some states are still getting worse.

---

Day 7 of 10. We just went national.

→ National trend 2018–2025 — the collapse and partial recovery
→ Compare any state vs national average — pick yours
→ Top 10 recovered states vs bottom 10 still in crisis
→ Full 50-state sortable table

States still above 30% absenteeism in 2024-25:
New Mexico. Nevada. District of Columbia. Oregon. Hawaii.

Tennessee? 18.3% — one of the strongest recoveries in the South.

All data from FutureEd State Absenteeism Tracker. Free to download.

Day 8 tomorrow.
